build.reason: The recipe runs Autotools and links $SRC/c-ares/.libs/libcares.a. The changed Automake target is in src/lib, and the updated repository test rules link src/lib/libcares.la. No step in the complete old recipe adjusts its archive path.

input.reason: The entry passes an unsigned-long input length to parsers accepting int; the supplied packet does not establish a maximum input length for this target.

lifecycle.reason: The entry initializes each result pointer, frees non-null host entries or data, and retains no parser result across calls.

control_flow.reason: If built, the entry unconditionally calls its nine reply parsers on each input; the A and AAAA parsers delegate to the shared address-info parser.

accepted.requirement: Link the fuzz target against the library archive generated by the changed Autotools build.
accepted.target_route: build.sh runs buildconf, configure and make all, then invokes $CXX to link ares_parse_reply_fuzzer against $SRC/c-ares/.libs/libcares.a.
accepted.failure_condition: The library target is now defined in src/lib, so a fresh changed-source build places its libtool archive under src/lib rather than at the top-level .libs path named in the old link command.
accepted.alternative_paths: The complete old build recipe gives no alternate archive, search directory, or fallback link command. The repository's updated test link rules use src/lib/libcares.la.

source_evidence.quote:
# Makefile.inc provides the CSOURCES and HHEADERS defines
include Makefile.inc

libcares_la_SOURCES = $(CSOURCES) $(HHEADERS)

CHANGE g0115 ADDED part 1/1 encoding=literal
EXTRA_DIST=CMakeLists.txt
SUBDIRS=lib tools

harness_evidence.quote:
./buildconf
./configure --enable-debug
make clean
make -j$(nproc) V=1 all

# Build the fuzzers.
$CC $CFLAGS -I. -c $SRC/c-ares/test/ares-test-fuzz.c -o $WORK/ares-test-fuzz.o
$CXX $CXXFLAGS -std=c++11 $WORK/ares-test-fuzz.o \
    -o $OUT/ares_parse_reply_fuzzer \
    $LIB_FUZZING_ENGINE $SRC/c-ares/.libs/libcares.a

assumptions: The supplied recipe runs from a fresh source checkout, as indicated by its buildconf, configure, make clean and make all sequence.
